input: arbitrary finite 3-CNF F with n original variables, m clauses and q literal occurrences

occurrence_local_determinant.occurrence_bits: Create one Boolean z_o for each literal occurrence o; z_o denotes the value of the underlying original variable, independent across occurrences at this stage.
occurrence_local_determinant.literal_false_indicator: For a positive occurrence x_i use f_o=1-z_o; for a negative occurrence NOT x_i use f_o=z_o.
occurrence_local_determinant.clause_gadget: For clause occurrences o1,o2,o3 define G_C=[[1,f_o1,0],[0,1,f_o2],[-f_o3,0,1]].
occurrence_local_determinant.clause_identity: det(G_C)=1-f_o1 f_o2 f_o3, which is exactly the OR-clause satisfaction indicator on the occurrence values.
occurrence_local_determinant.global_identity: D_F(z)=det M_F(z)=product_C clause_indicator_C(z) is in {0,1} and equals 1 iff every clause is satisfied under the occurrence-local assignment z.
occurrence_local_determinant.rank_one_property: Each occurrence variable z_o appears in exactly one matrix entry. Therefore M_F(z)=M_0+sum_o z_o u_o v_o^T with one rank-one update per occurrence.

consistency_projection.groups: For original variable i let O_i be its set of occurrence indices and d_i=|O_i|. A local occurrence assignment corresponds to one original assignment iff all z_o for o in O_i are equal for every i.
consistency_projection.even_character_subspace: E={s in {0,1}^q : sum_{o in O_i}s_o =0 mod 2 for every original variable i}.
consistency_projection.master_identity: #SAT(F)=2^(n-q) sum_{s in E} Dhat_F(s), ignoring variables with zero occurrences or accounting for them by the obvious factor 2.

determinant_evaluation_of_each_character.weights: For fixed s set t_o=(-1)^(s_o) and T_s=diag(t_o).
determinant_evaluation_of_each_character.v0_9_application: Dhat_F(s)=det([[M_0,U],[-T_s V^T,I+T_s]]), where U=[u_o] and V=[v_o].
determinant_evaluation_of_each_character.dimension: The determinant dimension is 3m+q, polynomial in |F|.
determinant_evaluation_of_each_character.bitlength: All frozen gadget entries are in {-2,-1,0,1,2}; exact integer determinant bitlength is polynomially bounded in matrix dimension by Hadamard's bound.

exact_remaining_problem.name: PARITY_SUBSPACE_DETERMINANT_SUM_FOR_OCCURRENCE_GADGETS
exact_remaining_problem.task: Compute S_F=sum_{s in E} det([[M_0,U],[-T_s V^T,I+T_s]]) in polynomial time without enumerating E.
exact_remaining_problem.dimension_of_E: q-rank(H), where H has one parity row per nonempty occurrence group; for ordinary formulas this is q-n_nonempty, so direct enumeration remains exponential in general.
exact_remaining_problem.decision_relation: S_F=2^(q-n) #SAT(F), hence S_F>0 iff F is satisfiable over the integers.
exact_remaining_problem.scientific_meaning: A polynomial exact algorithm for this frozen structured determinant-sum problem would give a polynomial algorithm for arbitrary 3-SAT (indeed exact #SAT after the known power-of-two scaling). This is the new direct-PVNP frontier, not an already-solved subroutine.

bounded_occurrence_note.statement: Using standard bounded-occurrence reductions can keep each d_i constant (e.g. at most four in classical 3-SAT hardness constructions), but the number of groups is still linear, so multiplying constant-size local Fourier expansions still yields exponentially many global character combinations unless the parity-subspace sum is globally compressed.
bounded_occurrence_note.firewall: Constant occurrence degree is not itself a polynomial algorithm.

next_target.name: E8_PARITY_SUBSPACE_DETERMINANT_SUM_COMPRESSION_V1_1
attack: Exploit that every character choice only flips/scales one bottom row of the v0.9 augmented matrix.
Search for a Pfaffian/matchgate or other parity-native contraction that sums all even masks within all disjoint occurrence groups simultaneously.
Reject any construction whose auxiliary state tensor-products across groups to exponential dimension.
Test any proposed identity on exhaustive small 3-CNF before theorem promotion.

scientific_ceiling.PROVED_IF_REPLAY_PASSES: Exact algebraic reduction of arbitrary 3-SAT/#SAT to a parity-subspace sum of polynomial-size determinants with rank-one occurrence structure.
